name: Fuse Button
description: A button that lights a fuse with one press and gives you until it burns out to take it back; when the fuse runs out, the action is committed.
interactionNotes: Press the button; a glowing ring around the pill starts burning and the label changes to "Undo". While the fuse burns, a click or `Escape` takes the action back. If you let the fuse finish, a check appears and the action is committed. With a mouse, keeping the pointer on the button freezes the fuse and it continues when the pointer leaves — the same default behavior.

props.name: label
props.description: Label of the idle state.

props.name: undoLabel
props.description: Label of the armed state; until the fuse burns out the whole pill is the undo button.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: Shown on the final face with a check, and announced to screen readers when arming.

props.name: icon
props.description: Idle icon; if omitted, the inline archive icon.

props.name: color
props.description: Ink of the label and icon; the streaks and undertones are derived from it.

props.name: background
props.description: Surface of the pill.

props.name: fuseColor
props.description: The glowing line or ring.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of 36, 44, or 52 pixels with matching type and icon.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner roundness, px; 22 is a full pill at the medium size.

props.name: undoWindow
props.description: How many milliseconds the fuse burns and undo is offered.

props.name: fuse
props.description: The ring around the pill that burns clockwise, or a line on the bottom or top edge.

props.name: fuseThickness
props.description: Thickness of the line or of the ring's stroke, px.

props.name: crossfadeMs
props.description: Crossfade of the faces after a pointer press; the keyboard switches without a transition.

props.name: commitOn
props.description: When `onCommit` is called: on press with undo as the way back, or only after the fuse ends.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Moving the mouse in and out freezes the fuse until the next pointer exit.

props.name: settle
props.description: After the fuse, go back to the initial state or stay on the done face to be mounted again.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the idle face and ignores presses; undoing mid-fuse still works.

props.name: autoPreview
props.description: Site preview only: it alternately burns the fuse to the end and hits "Undo" mid-burn. Keep it off in normal use.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: The main action — at the moment `commitOn` specifies.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: When undo or `Escape` takes the action back.

props.name: onFuseEnd
props.description: When the window closes without an undo.

props.name: onPhaseChange
props.description: On every phase change.

props.name: type
props.description: Type of the idle button.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the pill.

tips: `commitOn` determines the meaning of `label`: with `press` the label should state the action ("Delete"), while with `fuseEnd` it can be an invitation ("Press to delete").
With `settle="stay"` the final face stays; to run it again you must mount the component again with a fresh `key` — the component itself follows the same contract.
`pauseOnHover` only works with the mouse pointer; on touch, lifting the finger means the fuse continues — because touch has no notion of "hover".
For an irreversible action, do not use `commitOn="fuseEnd"`; instead wait inside `onCommit`: with `press`, the user has a way back until the last moment.
`disabled` does not close undo mid-fuse — this is deliberate: whoever started the action must be able to cancel it.
The fuse burns with WAAPI, not CSS; so `undoWindow` is the physics of the motion, not just display duration. Shortening it really shortens the undo window.
This component does not go right-to-left: the layout is centered and the fuse empties from the left as in the default. Only the texts are Persian.
